header: What the changeover form is going to ask you
subheader: Four steps, about 45 minutes together, and you can stop at any point.
lead: Put the article export from your old till and the type plates of your printers within reach before you start. Between them they are half the form.
note: The form itself is on the next page. Once it is in we come back within one working day with a date for the changeover.

steps.title: Business and branches
steps.text: Registered name, VAT number, and every branch with its address and opening hours. The VAT number is checked while you type it.

steps.title: Articles and prices
steps.text: Fastest with an export from the old till. Failing that, enter the thirty best sellers now and the long tail later.

steps.title: Hardware
steps.text: Which printers, which scales, which card terminal. A model number is enough, and a photograph of the type plate is just as good.

steps.title: Check and send
steps.text: Everything once more on a single page. Nothing is sent before you press the button on that page.
